crossRefs.note: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and confused them.

translations.web: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.
translations.bsb: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
